office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the Wahkiakum County Superior Court: keeping its record, issuing court orders, handling court money and managing juries.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Jess Reddon (Prefers Independent Party), elected in 2025 to the rest of the previous term, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Wahkiakum County Clerk since the November 2025 election; the only candidate.
highlights: Elected unopposed in November 2025 with 1,445 votes [S4]
